description: WHEN: use it only after the traveller has (1) picked ONE category and dates, (2) given name, email and phone, and (3) EXPLICITLY accepted the cancellation policy — never set `accepted_terms: true` on your own. WHAT IT RETURNS: `booking_id`, `checkout_url` (a page on beachvalencia.com that shows the breakdown and asks the guest to tick the cancellation policy BEFORE jumping to Stripe), `expires_at` (ISO 8601, ~30 min in the future), `hold_minutes: 30`, total/nightly EUR, nights, guests, property, deposit, cancellation summary, `terms_url`, `idempotent` (true if a prior request with the same category+dates+pax+email was replayed), and a `message` ready to show to the guest. PAYMENT: always on Stripe, hosted at beachvalencia.com. The agent NEVER charges the guest itself. If the hold expires without payment, the unit is released automatically and a new request is needed. The price is the public rate (no member discount, no coupon codes — if the guest has a code, they apply it on the web). IDEMPOTENCY: a replay with the same category, dates, pax and email returns the same booking. EXAMPLE: {"id":"G4","check_in":"2027-05-22","check_out":"2027-05-27","adults":4,"guest_name":"Ada Lovelace","guest_email":"ada@example.com","guest_phone":"+34612345678","language":"en","accepted_terms":true}.

accepted_terms.description: Must be true. The agent confirms the traveller accepted the cancellation policy and the terms and conditions.

check_out.description: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Madrid); strictly after check_in.

children.description: Optional list of children ages. Only the count is used to size the property.

guest_email.description: Guest's email — receives the payment link and confirmation.

guest_phone.description: Guest's phone number, including country code.

language.description: Language for the confirmation email and error messages.
